title: [Harness Sovereign] Phase 1: Native direct multi-provider router replacing LiteLLM
goal: Implement native Rust multi-provider HTTP routing in susi-adapters-llm and susi-harness to dispatch requests directly to upstream model providers (DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Anthropic) without requiring LiteLLM or Python subprocesses. Connect to the native ResponseCache and ledger for cost attribution.
